name: Sinharaja Canopy Walk
description: The Sinharaja Canopy Walk, nestled within the Sinharaja Forest Reserve, offers visitors an adventurous experience high above the lush jungle canopy. This nature walk attracts bird enthusiasts and photographers alike, as they marvel at the diverse array of avian life while suspended 30 meters above the forest floor. Established to protect the unique biodiversity of the area, this walkway is a testament to efforts to preserve Sri Lanka's last remaining lowland rainforest. Visitors can observe endemic species such as the Sri Lankan Jungle Fowl and Blue-faced Malkoha, adding to the rich cultural and natural heritage of Ratnapura.

name: Adam's Peak Night Trek
description: Experience the spiritual journey to Adam’s Peak under the moonlight. This iconic pilgrimage site offers breathtaking views and a profound connection with the sacred Buddha Tooth Relic Temple. Witness the awe-inspiring sight of pilgrims climbing the peak at night, creating a mesmerizing spectacle against the starry backdrop.

name: Ratnapura River Rafting
description: Experience the Ratnapura River Rafting, a thrilling adventure where adrenaline-pumping rafting trips through the lush Sabaragamuwa province await. Nestled in the heart of nature, this park offers a unique glimpse into Sri Lanka’s natural beauty and cultural heritage.
monsoon_note: May-Sept heavy SW monsoon; Sinharaja always wet

name: Elephant Transit Home
description: Elephant Transit Home, an adventure park in Ratnapura, Sri Lanka, offers visitors the unique experience of wildlife watching, focusing on observing elephants in their natural habitat. The park, established as a sanctuary for displaced elephants, provides a safe environment where tourists can learn about these majestic creatures. Established in the early 21st century, it has become a popular spot for nature enthusiasts and those interested in conservation efforts. Visitors can watch the elephants interact with each other and with handlers, gaining insights into their behavior and care.
